fact: KINIX (Kinshasa Internet Exchange), founded in 2012 and run by ISPA-DRC as one of three community IXPs of the RDC-IX project, was operating with more than 20 participating networks when it relocated its infrastructure into the Raxio DRC data centre in Kinshasa, per Raxio Group's 20 August 2026 statement.

ACIX (Africa Congo Internet Exchange), established in 2023 and operated by DE-CIX for the NGO Internet pour Tous, was in service in Kinshasa and expanded to a second data-centre site in OADC Texaf's Kinshasa FIH1 facility, per ITWeb Africa on 19 May 2026.
